description: This file provides utility functions for generating and working with PEP 425 compatibility tags, including platform and interpreter support, especially tailored for different operating systems and architecture considerations.

methods.name: str version_info_to_nodot(version_info: Tuple[int, ...])
methods.description: Converts a tuple representing version info to a string with no dot, using only the first two elements.

methods.name: List[str] _mac_platforms(arch: str)
methods.description: Generates a list of macOS platform strings based on architecture details, using regex parsing.

methods.name: List[str] _custom_manylinux_platforms(arch: str)
methods.description: Generates platform strings for the manylinux standards, considering compatibility and backward compatibility levels.

methods.name: List[str] _get_custom_platforms(arch: str)
methods.description: Determines specific platform strings based on provided architecture, handling macOS and manylinux variants.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] _expand_allowed_platforms(platforms: Optional[List[str]])
methods.description: Expands a list of platforms to include all relevant derived platforms, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: PythonVersion _get_python_version(version: str)
methods.description: Parses a version string into a PythonVersion tuple, supporting major and minor version components.

methods.name: str _get_custom_interpreter( implementation: Optional[str] = None, version: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Constructs a string identifier for the Python implementation and version, defaulting to current interpreter info.

methods.name: List[Tag] get_supported( version: Optional[str] = None, platforms: Optional[List[str]] = None, impl: Optional[str] = None, abis: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a list of compatible tags based on specified Python version, platforms, implementation, and ABIs, for use in package compatibility checks.

ctags.name: _get_custom_interpreter
ctags.signature: ( implementation: Optional[str] = None, version: Optional[str] = None )

ctags.name: get_supported
ctags.signature: ( version: Optional[str] = None, platforms: Optional[List[str]] = None, impl: Optional[str] = None, abis: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
